name: Terfens
kurzbeschreibung: Modern residential community in the Unterinntal with a contemporary leisure area and beautiful surroundings in the Inntal.
beschreibung:
Terfens lies at an elevation of 591 m in the Unterinntal at the entrance to the Zillertal, between Schwaz and Jenbach in the district of Schwaz. The municipality with around 2,200 inhabitants extends over several small hamlets such as Umlberg and Hochpillberg, which nestle against the slope at the foot of the Karwendelgebirge. Despite its convenient location on the Inntalautobahn, the village retains its rural character with agricultural structure and intact meadows.

The centerpiece for families and those seeking relaxation is the expansive Terfens leisure area with a swimming lake, playground, beach volleyball courts, and a Kneipp facility. From here, hikes start toward Hochpillberg, where in summer the via ferrata and panorama trail attract visitors, while in winter the Pillberg-Skilift appeals to young skiers. The Inn-Radweg runs directly past the village and connects Terfens with the Zillertal as well as with the provincial capital Innsbruck. The pilgrimage church Maria Schnee, built in 1713 on the hill above the village, is a quiet cultural attraction with Baroque furnishings.

In culinary terms, Terfens benefits from the agriculture of the Zillertal – regional products such as Zillertaler Bergkäse and farm-produced juices can be found at the local farm shops. Anyone who stops here gets honest Tiroler cuisine without tourist crowds, as the village lies away from the major hotspots.
